fix.change: A messageRef mirror plus a streamNoticeRef holding the exact capacity/channel-loss notice currently on screen (set only for the capacity and channel kinds — the auth refusal is an authorization fact a recovered picture must not mask). When a VALID frame arrives — after the existing abort/generation guards, session/target/generation match and frameSource parse, at the same point the reconnect budget resets — the obsolete notice is replaced with 画面连接已恢复。, gated on it still being the message on screen.
guarantees: A newer input, composition, submission, lease or other action/success message is never erased (equality gate against the mirrored latest notice).
Malformed, stale (other session/target/host generation), hidden/unmounted or unrelated frames never trigger the replacement (all existing validation runs first).
Frames still grant no control authority; requester-bound held receipts, retry bounds, draft/IME/receipt semantics and no-replay behavior are unchanged.
A stream recovery cannot disguise an independently failed authorization/control channel: the auth-refusal and control-channel notices are not stream notices.
